subject.title: Gateway: account-scoped channel config changes restart the entire channel and can disrupt active traffic

question: Should generic `channels.<kind>.accounts.<accountId>` config changes restart only that account across channel plugins by default, with documented whole-channel fallbacks for default/global/mixed/unlisted cases?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fix changes a shared gateway reload contract for all channel plugins, which is compatibility-sensitive and needs owner intent before the candidate PR lands.

options.title: Confirm Generic Account-Scoped Reloads
options.body: Approve the current candidate shape so account-scoped config changes restart only affected accounts while whole-channel fallbacks preserve safety for broader cases.

options.title: Require Plugin Opt-In
options.body: Keep current whole-channel behavior unless a channel plugin explicitly declares support for account-scoped reloads.

options.title: Defer Contract Change
options.body: Leave the issue open while gateway owners define a narrower reload capability contract before landing code.

recommendation.title: Confirm Generic Account-Scoped Reloads
recommendation.body: Approve the current candidate shape so account-scoped config changes restart only affected accounts while whole-channel fallbacks preserve safety for broader cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent PR metadata make vincentkoc the strongest route for the reload planner and channel lifecycle contract decision.
